vscode-modx.elementsPath.description: Directory with file elements to load via @FILE binding. Relative to the workspace root. Use `/`, `.`, or an empty value to browse from the project root.
vscode-modx.diagnostics.description: Report structural problems in templates: constructs that are never closed, and unpaired tags.
vscode-modx.diagnostics.unclosed: Constructs that are never closed, and unpaired Fenom block tags.
vscode-modx.diagnostics.all: The same, plus unpaired HTML elements. Useful on whole pages; a chunk that opens an element another chunk closes is reported as a problem.
